about: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written for this atlas in our own words; the sources named beside each guide are where its facts come from. A guide that cannot yet pin a trigger down says so plainly instead of inventing one. This revision adds, for every trophy, a tickable step-by-step breakdown, a one-line timing note and a confidence note, all built from the same cited sources as the guide they sit under.

sourcesIndex.label: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap

trophies.guide: This is the platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then strands and clean-up — and treat this entry as your final progress check. No online play and no difficulty setting are involved in any part of the list.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.label: PowerPyx roadmap (no online or difficulty trophies)

steps: Treat this one as the seal on the whole list rather than a task: it simply watches the other 54 trophies and completes when they do.
Work the roadmap order on this page — story first, side threads next, then the sweeps and tallies, and the open-world residue last — so nothing is left stranded at the end.
When the 54th other trophy lands, this one follows on its own; there is no extra feat, item or ending attached to it.
trophies.timing: Last by definition: the instant the other 54 are all earned.
trophies.confidence: High — read straight from the official description

trophies.guide: A story trophy that unlocks automatically when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. You cannot miss it by exploring or taking your time — just play the introduction through to its end. Because there is no mission replay, keep a manual save once the chapter settles if you like having a return point, but this trophy itself needs no special action.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.label: PowerPyx guide (automatic story trophy, Gone Fishing)

steps: Play the campaign in order; this trophy hangs on the story beat where you complete Gone Fishing.
No detour is needed — the moment sits on the critical path, so keep the chapter moving and let it arrive.
It lands as the scene resolves. If a checkpoint passes without it, replay the mission from chapter select instead of reloading an old save.
trophies.timing: On the story path, mid-campaign; it arrives with its chapter.
trophies.confidence: High — read straight from the official description

trophies.guide: The long gold. After the story, open Progress, then Stats, then the 100% Completion checklist and work it down; progress you made during the story already counts, and guides stress the checklist is more forgiving than its name — roughly three fifths of everything in the game, with partial targets such as 70 of 80 challenges and 15 of 18 card sets for this checklist. Finish it and both this trophy and most of the list fall together.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.timing: A long-tail tally toward 100; spread it across the whole playthrough instead of grinding it in one sitting.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the stunt events scattered across Leonida — jumps and set-piece stunts the game tracks as you clear them. Work them region by region whenever you pass one during the story and the checklist phase, rather than saving all 250 for one grind. Use the counter in this tracker each session; the in-game completion checklist needs a similar stunt total, so every stunt here is progress twice over. If a jump keeps failing, change the approach vehicle before you change your line — most stunts are tuned for one vehicle class, and the note field on this trophy is the place to record which class worked.

None of them needs a win or a medal for this trophy, just a genuine attempt, so clear it early: one lap through the activity icons on the map unlocks it and shows you which activities you actually enjoy grinding for their own trophies later.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Push Square names two range locations to start from — Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — and you can find ranges through the map's Activities filter. Practise each weapon class until its gold score is routine; range work also builds the Focus stat that Gunslinger depends on, so do this before that trophy. Gold is per challenge, not per range: one range holds several weapon-class challenges, so clear a whole range before travelling to the next — backtracking across Leonida costs more time than one stubborn gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. A single win per location is enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist counts all 42 drone races across those same locations, so the efficient play is to finish every race at a location while you are there, then move on. Learn a course with a sighting run first — drone races punish memorised-late turns more than raw speed. Log each location's first win in this tracker the moment it lands: fourteen scattered wins are exactly the kind of progress that is easy to lose count of without one.

If Cal wins, the challenge can be attempted again; nothing about it is one-shot.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full mission strands for strangers, anywhere in Leonida. A strand means the character's whole chain, not their first job, so the six character-final trophies in this list are your backbone: finish Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, then complete three more strands you meet while exploring. The counter here is built for exactly this bookkeeping — strands are long, and half-finished ones look finished on the map. Bret's hunt (Fair Game) counts toward the eight as well; if you reach the endgame two strands short, look in the districts you rushed during the story — strands wait where the story did not linger.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots, in 10 locations, with both protagonists where the game offers it. THE missable warning of this list: the first spot is at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept, and she teaches you to meditate. Guides report that spot is gone for good after Chapter 1, so do it before anything else, then sweep the remaining spots region by region.
trophies.missableNote: Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house is reported permanently unavailable after Chapter 1 (PowerPyx, GTABase). Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save.

sources.label: PowerPyx guide (18 spots, Chapter 1 missable meditation, exact scene)

steps: In Chapter 1 the story brings you to Jason's house; before you leave the property, step out onto the balcony.
Stay out there a moment and take in the view — the official description ties the trophy to that pause, and the story never returns you to this exact spot.
It pops as the moment registers. Played past it already? A fresh run through Chapter 1 is the only way back, so do it before anything else on a new save.
trophies.timing: One window only — Chapter 1, at Jason's house. Gone once you leave.
trophies.confidence: High — read straight from the official description

trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting job and bring down the unique animal it names. Hunting is an activity type, and studying animals through binoculars during the story builds the animal knowledge the 100% checklist later asks for in bulk. Follow Bret's lead on where the animal ranges rather than free-hunting the map — this trophy is about his specific quarry, not a species count.

trophies.guide: Complete any three full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and the 100% checklist wants 15 of them, so treat cards as a whole-game habit: grab every card you pass, and use this tracker's counter for finished sets rather than loose cards. Push Square keeps an index of card locations if you want to close a nearly finished set first — finishing sets, not collecting singles, is what this trophy counts. Start with the shortest sets: a finished small set counts exactly as much as a finished large one, so three quick sets bank this trophy early while the 15-set checklist goal keeps collecting in the background.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK at 100 different locations around Leonida. This is a sweep trophy: it rewards covering the map methodically, district by district, instead of revisiting favourite spots. Pair it with The Goodtime State — while you are clearing map fog in a new area, clear its WAiNK spots too, and log the running total here so a late-game audit is a short list, not a full re-sweep. WAiNK spots cluster around named locations rather than open countryside, so sweep settlement by settlement and the 100 breaks into short evening sessions instead of one map-wide grind.
